# Supplier Register Policy

## Purpose

The firm keeps one register of every supplier it depends on, and reviews it
every quarter. This note is the build command's fixture, so it carries one of
each thing the walker counts.

## Scope

Every arrangement in which a third party performs work the firm would otherwise
do itself, with **bold**, *italic* and ==mark==, and a [link](https://example.com/register).

- The register names the supplier and the service.
- It records the owner.
  - And the date the arrangement was last reviewed.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The supplier's legal name |
| Owner | The person accountable for the arrangement |
